description: This line plot illustrates the perplexity of three different large language models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—as a function of the parameter M, which is plotted on the x-axis. The x-axis, labeled “M”, uses a linear scale ranging from 3 to 7, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled “Perplexity”, uses a linear scale ranging from 20.0 to 40.0, with tick marks at intervals of 10.0. The plot displays three distinct lines: the LLaMA1-7B model is represented by a green line with circular markers, the LLaMA1-13B model by an orange line with star-shaped markers, and the Vicuna-7B model by a blue line with triangular markers. The green line (LLaMA1-7B) starts at a perplexity of approximately 28.0 when M=3, dips slightly to around 26.0 at M=4, remains relatively flat near 26.0 until M=6, and then rises to about 36.0 at M=7. The orange line (LLaMA1-13B) begins at approximately 20.0 when M=3, decreases to about 18.0 at M=4, and then remains nearly constant at around 18.0 until M=7, where it slightly increases to about 20.0. The blue line (Vicuna-7B) starts at approximately 40.0 when M=3, decreases to about 36.0 at M=4, remains relatively flat near 36.0 until M=6, and then rises to about 40.0 at M=7.
